title.zh: 卷九十六 志第四十九 河渠六
title.raw: 卷九十六 志第四十九 河渠六 Volume 96 Treatises 49: Rivers and Canals 6

sentences.zh: 東南諸水上

translations.literal: The waters of the southeast, part one.
translations.idiomatic: Southeastern Waters (Part One)

sentences.zh: 開寶間，議征江南。

translations.literal: During the Kaibao period, [the court] discussed campaigning against Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaibao reign, the court debated an expedition against the Jiangnan region.

sentences.zh: 詔用京西轉運使李符之策，發和州丁夫及鄉兵凡數萬人，鑿橫江渠于曆陽，令符督其役。

translations.literal: An edict adopted the plan of Li Fu, transport commissioner of Jingxi, mobilizing corvée laborers and militia from Hezhou totaling tens of thousands of men to dig the Hengjiang Canal at Liyang, and ordered Fu to supervise the work.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the plan of Li Fu, transport commissioner for Jingxi, who raised tens of thousands of corvée laborers and local militia from He Prefecture to cut the Cross-River Canal at Liyang; Li Fu was put in charge of the project.

sentences.zh: 渠成，以通漕運，而軍用無闕。

translations.literal: When the canal was completed, it connected the grain-transport route, and military supplies were not wanting.
translations.idiomatic: Once the canal was finished, it opened the grain transport route, and military provisions were never in short supply.

sentences.zh: 八年，知瓊州李易上言：「州南五里有度靈塘，開修渠堰，溉水田三百余頃，居民賴之。」

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Li Yi, prefect of Qiongzhou, submitted a memorial: "Five li south of the prefecture is Dulings Pond; by opening and repairing canals and barrages, more than three hundred qing of paddy may be irrigated, and the inhabitants rely on it."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Li Yi, governor of Qiongzhou, reported: "Five li south of the prefectural seat lies Dulings Pond. By clearing and repairing its channels and weirs, over three hundred qing of flooded fields could be irrigated, and the local people depend upon it."

sentences.zh: 初，楚州北山陽灣尤迅急，多有沈溺之患。

translations.literal: Formerly, at Beishan Yang Bay in Chuzhou the current was especially swift and urgent, and there were many disasters of foundering.
translations.idiomatic: Long before this, the current at Beishan Yang Bay north of Chuzhou ran especially fast, and many vessels were lost to sinking.

sentences.zh: 雍熙中，轉運使劉蟠議開沙河，以避淮水之險，未克而受代。

translations.literal: In the Yongxi period, transport commissioner Liu Pan proposed opening the Sha River to avoid the peril of the Huai, but did not succeed before he was replaced.
translations.idiomatic: During Yongxi, transport commissioner Liu Pan proposed digging the Sha River to bypass the dangers of the Huai, but the work was not finished before he left office.

sentences.zh: 喬維岳繼之，開河自楚州至淮陰，凡六十里，舟行便之。

translations.literal: Qiao Weiyue succeeded him, opening a channel from Chuzhou to Huaiyin, altogether sixty li, so that boats could travel conveniently.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Weiyue took over and opened a river from Chuzhou to Huaiyin, sixty li in all, which made navigation far easier.

sentences.zh: 天禧元年，知升州丁謂言：「城北有後湖，往時歲旱水竭，給為民田，凡七十六頃，出租錢數百萬，蔭溉之利遂廢。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianxi, Ding Wei, prefect of Shengzhou, said: "North of the city is Hou Lake; in former times, when drought dried the water, it was allotted as farmland, seventy-six qing in all, yielding rent of several million in cash, and the benefit of shade and irrigation was thus abandoned."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianxi, Ding Wei, governor of Sheng Prefecture, reported: "North of the city lies Hou Lake. In years past, when drought drained it, the lakebed was parceled out as farmland—seventy-six qing in all—bringing in millions in rent, while the benefits of irrigation and shade were lost."

sentences.zh: 令欲改田除租，跡舊制，復治岸畔，疏為塘陂以畜水，使負郭無旱歲，廣植浦芡，養魚鱉，縱貧民漁采。

translations.literal: Now I wish to convert the fields and remove the rent, follow the old regulations, restore the banks, dredge ponds and barrages to store water, so that the suburbs have no drought years, widely plant water chestnuts and gorgon fruit, raise fish and turtles, and allow the poor to fish and gather.
translations.idiomatic: I propose to restore the farmland to the lake, cancel the rent, follow the old regulations, rebuild the banks, and dredge ponds and reservoirs to hold water so the suburbs never suffer drought. We could plant water chestnuts and gorgon fruit widely, raise fish and turtles, and let the poor fish and forage freely.

sentences.zh: 」又明州請免濠池及慈溪、鄞縣陂湖年課，許民射利。

translations.literal: Mingzhou also requested exemption from the annual levy on the moat ponds and the barrage lakes of Cixi and Yin counties, permitting the people to pursue profit.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Prefecture also asked that the annual levy on the moat ponds and the reservoir lakes of Cixi and Yin counties be waived, allowing commoners to profit from them.

sentences.zh: 詔並從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved all [these proposals].
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all of these proposals.

sentences.zh: 二年，江、淮發運使賈宗言：「諸路歲漕，自真、揚入淮、汴，曆堰者五，糧載煩於剝卸，民力罷於牽挽，官私船艦，由此速壞。

translations.literal: In the second year, Jia Zongyan, transport commissioner for the Jiang-Huai region, said: "The annual grain transport of the various circuits, from Zhen and Yang into the Huai and Bian, passes five barrages; grain loads are troubled by transshipment, the people's strength is exhausted by hauling, and official and private vessels are quickly ruined thereby."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Jia Zongyan, Jiang-Huai transport commissioner, reported: "Annual tribute grain from every circuit passes from Zhen and Yang into the Huai and Bian, crossing five barrages. Cargo must be unloaded and reloaded at each lock, laborers are worn out hauling boats, and both government and private vessels are ruined in the process."

sentences.zh: 今議開揚州古河，繚城南接運渠，毀龍舟、新興、茱萸三堰，鑿近堰漕路，以均水勢。

translations.literal: Now it is proposed to open the ancient river of Yangzhou, winding around the south of the city to connect with the transport canal, destroy the three barrages of Longzhou, Xinxing, and Zhuyu, and cut a transport route near the barrages to equalize the water level.
translations.idiomatic: We propose reopening Yangzhou's ancient river, skirting the south of the city to join the transport canal, demolishing the Longzhou, Xinxing, and Zhuyu barrages, and cutting a new transport channel near the locks to even out the water level.

sentences.zh: 歲省官費十數萬，功利甚厚。

translations.literal: Each year it would save official expenses of several hundred thousand, and the benefit would be very great.
translations.idiomatic: This would save the government several hundred thousand cash each year, with substantial overall benefit.

sentences.zh: 」詔屯田郎中梁楚、閣門祗候李居中按視，以為當然。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Liang Chu of the Bureau of State Farms and Li Juzhong, gate attendant, to inspect on site, and they judged it appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Liang Chu of the Bureau of State Farms and Li Juzhong, a gate attendant, to inspect the site; they reported that the plan was sound.

sentences.zh: 明年，役既成，而水注新河，與三堰平，漕船無阻，公私大便。

translations.literal: The next year, when the work was completed, water poured into the new river and stood level with the three barrages; grain-transport vessels met no obstruction, and public and private [interests] were greatly benefited.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the project was finished. Water flowed into the new channel and stood level with the three former barrages; grain boats passed without hindrance, to the great benefit of government and merchants alike.

sentences.zh: 四年，淮南勸農使王貫之導海州石闥堰水入漣水軍，溉民田；

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Wang Guanzhi, agricultural commissioner of Huainan, led the water of the Shita barrage in Haizhou into Lianshui Army to irrigate the people's fields;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Wang Guanzhi, Huainan agricultural commissioner, diverted water from the Shita barrage in Haizhou into Lianshui Army district to irrigate farmland;

sentences.zh: 知定遠縣江澤、知江陰軍崔立率民修廢塘，浚古港，以灌高仰之地。

translations.literal: Jiang Ze, magistrate of Dingyuan County, and Cui Li, military prefect of Jiangyin, led the people to repair abandoned ponds, dredge ancient harbors, and irrigate high-lying land.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Ze, magistrate of Dingyuan County, and Cui Li, commander of Jiangyin Army, led the people in repairing abandoned ponds and dredging old harbors to water fields on higher ground.

sentences.zh: 並賜詔獎焉。

translations.literal: All were granted edicts of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: All received imperial edicts of commendation.

sentences.zh: 神宗熙甯元年十月，詔：「杭之長安、秀之杉青、常之望亭三堰，監護使臣並以'管幹河塘'系銜，常同所屬令佐，巡視修固，以時啟閉。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Xining under Emperor Shenzong, an edict said: "The three barrages of Chang'an in Hang, Shanqing in Xiu, and Wangting in Chang—the supervising commissioners shall all bear the additional title 'Director of River Ponds,' and regularly together with their subordinate magistrates and assistants inspect, repair, and strengthen [them], opening and closing them at the proper times."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Xining, Emperor Shenzong decreed: "For the three barrages at Chang'an in Hangzhou, Shanqing in Xiuzhou, and Wangting in Changzhou, the supervising commissioners shall all take the additional title 'Director of River Ponds' and, together with their local magistrates and assistants, regularly inspect and maintain them, opening and closing the locks on schedule."

sentences.zh: 」從堤舉兩浙開修河渠胡淮之請也。

translations.literal: This followed the request of Hu Huai, who had been nominated to open and repair rivers and canals in the two Zhe circuits.
translations.idiomatic: This followed a petition from Hu Huai, who had been nominated to oversee river and canal works in the two Zhe circuits.

sentences.zh: 二年三月甲申，先是，淩民瞻建議廢呂城堰，又即望亭堰置閘而不用。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the third month of the second year—before this, Ling Minzhan had proposed abolishing the Lücheng barrage, and at Wangting barrage had installed gates but did not use them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the third month of the second year: earlier, Ling Minzhan had proposed abolishing the Lücheng barrage and had installed gates at Wangting barrage but left them unused.

sentences.zh: 及因浚河，隳敗古涇函、石閘、石鹈達，河流益阻，百姓勞弊，至是，民瞻等貶降有差。

translations.literal: When, because of dredging the river, the ancient sluice culverts, stone gates, and Shitida [structures] were destroyed, the river flow became more obstructed and the people were worn out with hardship; at this point Minzhan and others were demoted to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Dredging work then destroyed the ancient sluice culverts, stone gates, and Shitida structures, making the river even harder to navigate and exhausting the populace. At this point Minzhan and his associates were demoted to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，杭州于潛縣令郟亶言：「蘇州環湖地卑多水，沿海地高多旱，故古人治水之跡，縱則有浦，橫則有塘，又有門堰、涇瀝而棋布之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year, Zheng Dan, magistrate of Yuqian County in Hangzhou, said: "Around Suzhou the land is low and has much water; along the coast the land is high and has much drought. Therefore the traces of the ancients' water control: vertically there are channels, horizontally there are embankments, and moreover sluice gates, barrages, and drainage ditches arranged like a chessboard."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixth year, Zheng Dan, magistrate of Yuqian County in Hangzhou, reported: "Land around Lake Tai in Suzhou is low and prone to flooding, while coastal land is high and prone to drought. The ancients left their waterworks everywhere: longitudinal channels, transverse embankments, and sluice gates, barrages, and drainage ditches laid out like a chessboard."

sentences.zh: 今總二百六十餘所。

translations.literal: Today they total more than two hundred sixty places.
translations.idiomatic: Today more than two hundred sixty such works remain.

sentences.zh: 欲略循古人之法，七里為一縱浦，十里為一橫塘，又因出土，以為堤岸，度用夫二十萬。

translations.literal: I wish roughly to follow the ancients' method: every seven li one longitudinal channel, every ten li one transverse embankment, and moreover use the excavated earth to form dikes, estimating two hundred thousand laborers.
translations.idiomatic: I propose roughly following the ancient method: a longitudinal channel every seven li, a transverse embankment every ten li, using excavated earth to build dikes, at an estimated cost of two hundred thousand laborers.

sentences.zh: 水治高田，旱治下澤，不過三年，蘇之田畢治矣。

translations.literal: With water managing the high fields and drought managing the low marshes, in no more than three years all the fields of Su will be completely managed.
translations.idiomatic: Water would serve the high fields and drought the low marshes; within three years all farmland in Suzhou could be brought under control.

sentences.zh: 」十一月，命亶興修水利。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Dan was ordered to undertake water conservancy works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Zheng Dan was ordered to launch water conservancy projects.

sentences.zh: 然措置乖方，民多愁怨，僅及一年，遂罷兩浙工役。

translations.literal: However, the arrangements were ill-suited, the people were much aggrieved and resentful, and after barely a year the labor service in the two Zhe circuits was halted.
translations.idiomatic: But the execution was misguided, the people grew bitter, and after barely a year labor service in the two Zhe circuits was suspended.

sentences.zh: 又數月，中書檢正沈括復言：「浙西涇浜淺涸，當浚；

translations.literal: Several months later, Shen Kuo, reviewing secretary of the Secretariat, again said: "The channels and creeks of western Zhe are shallow and dry and should be dredged;
translations.idiomatic: Several months later, Shen Kuo of the Secretariat reported again: "The channels and creeks of western Zhe are shallow and dry and should be dredged;

sentences.zh: 浙東堤防川瀆堙沒，當修。

translations.literal: the dikes and defenses and rivers of eastern Zhe are silted up and buried and should be repaired.
translations.idiomatic: the dikes, rivers, and defenses of eastern Zhe are silted over and should be repaired.

sentences.zh: 請下司農貸緡募役。

translations.literal: I request that the Ministry of Revenue be ordered to lend cash and recruit corvée.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the Ministry of Revenue be directed to lend funds and hire labor for the work.

sentences.zh: 」從之，仍命括相度兩浙水利。

translations.literal: This was approved, and Kuo was still ordered to survey water conservancy in the two Zhe circuits.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed and also ordered Shen Kuo to survey waterworks throughout the two Zhe circuits.

sentences.zh: 九年正月壬午，劉瑾言：「揚州江都縣古鹽河、高郵縣陳公塘等湖、天長縣白馬塘沛塘、楚州寶應縣泥港射馬港、山陽縣渡塘溝龍興浦、淮陰縣青州澗、宿州虹縣萬安湖小河、壽州安豐縣芍陂等，可興置，欲令逐路轉運司選官覆按。

translations.literal: On renwu, the first month of the ninth year, Liu Jin said: "The ancient salt river of Jiangdu County in Yangzhou, Chen Gong Pond and other lakes of Gaoyou County, Baima Pond and Pei Pond of Tianchang County, Nigang and Shema harbors of Baoying County in Chuzhou, Dutang Ditch and Longxing Creek of Shanyang County, Qingzhou Stream of Huaiyin County, the small river of Wan'an Lake in Hong County of Suzhou, and Shaopi of Anfeng County in Shouzhou, among others, may be established; I wish each circuit transport office to select officials to re-inspect."
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the first month of the ninth year, Liu Jin reported: "Projects could be revived at the ancient salt river in Jiangdu County, Yangzhou; Chen Gong Pond and other lakes in Gaoyou County; Baima and Pei ponds in Tianchang County; Nigang and Shema harbors in Baoying County, Chuzhou; Dutang Ditch and Longxing Creek in Shanyang County; Qingzhou Stream in Huaiyin County; the small river of Wan'an Lake in Hong County, Suzhou; and Shaopi in Anfeng County, Shouzhou, among others. I ask that each circuit transport office select officials to reinspect these sites."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 元豐五年九月，淮南監司言：「舒州近城有大澤，出灊山，注北門外。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Yuanfeng, Huainan supervisory officials said: "Near the city of Shuzhou is a great marsh, issuing from Qian Mountain and pouring out north of the outer gate."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Yuanfeng, Huainan supervisory officials reported: "Near Shuzhou city lies a great marsh fed by Qian Mountain, which discharges north of the outer gate."

sentences.zh: 比者，暴水漂居民，知州楊希元築捍水堤千一百五十丈，置泄水斗門二，遂免淫潦入城之患。

translations.literal: Recently, sudden floodwaters swept away inhabitants; prefect Yang Xiyuan built flood-control dikes of one thousand one hundred fifty zhang and set up two sluice gates for drainage, thus avoiding the affliction of excessive flooding entering the city.
translations.idiomatic: Recently a flash flood swept away residents. Prefect Yang Xiyuan built flood-control dikes 1,150 zhang long and installed two drainage sluice gates, thereby preventing floodwaters from inundating the city.

sentences.zh: 」並璽書獎諭。

translations.literal: Imperial letters of seal-script commendation were sent to all.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial commendations under the imperial seal were sent to all involved.

sentences.zh: 六年正月戊辰，開龜山運河，二月乙未告成，長五十七里，闊十五丈，深一丈五尺。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the first month of the sixth year, the Guishan transport canal was opened; on yiwei in the second month it was announced completed, fifty-seven li long, fifteen zhang wide, and one zhang five chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the first month of the sixth year, work began on the Guishan transport canal; on yiwei day in the second month it was declared complete—fifty-seven li long, fifteen zhang wide, and one zhang five chi deep.

sentences.zh: 初，發運使許元自淮陰開新河，屬之洪澤，避長淮之險，凡四十九里。

translations.literal: Earlier, transport commissioner Xu Yuan had opened a new river from Huaiyin, connecting it to Hongze, avoiding the peril of the long Huai, altogether forty-nine li.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, transport commissioner Xu Yuan had cut a new channel from Huaiyin to Hongze Lake, forty-nine li in all, to bypass the dangers of the main Huai.

sentences.zh: 久而淺澀，熙寧四年，皮公弼請復浚治，起十一月壬寅，盡明年正月丁酉而畢，人便之。

translations.literal: After long years it became shallow and silted; in the fourth year of Xining, Pi Gongbi requested renewed dredging, beginning on renyin in the eleventh month and finishing on dingyou in the first month of the next year; people found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Over time it silted up. In the fourth year of Xining, Pi Gongbi petitioned for renewed dredging, starting on renyin day in the eleventh month and finishing on dingyou day in the first month of the following year, to everyone's benefit.

sentences.zh: 至是，發運使羅拯復欲自洪澤而上，鑿龜山裏河以達於淮，帝深然之。

translations.literal: At this time, transport commissioner Luo Zheng again wished from Hongze upstream to cut the inner Guishan river to reach the Huai; the emperor deeply approved.
translations.idiomatic: At this point transport commissioner Luo Zheng proposed cutting an inner channel at Guishan from Hongze upstream to reach the Huai, and the emperor strongly approved.

sentences.zh: 會發運使蔣之奇入對，建言：「上有清汴，下有洪澤，而風浪之險止百里淮，邇歲溺公私之載不可計。

translations.literal: When transport commissioner Jiang Zhiqi came to audience, he submitted a proposal: "Above there is the clear Bian, below there is Hongze, but the peril of wind and waves is only the hundred li of the Huai; in recent years the drowning of public and private cargoes cannot be counted."
translations.idiomatic: When transport commissioner Jiang Zhiqi came before the throne, he argued: "Above lies the clear Bian Canal, below Hongze Lake, yet the only real danger is the hundred li of the Huai. In recent years countless government and private cargoes have been lost there."

sentences.zh: 凡諸道轉輸，涉湖行江，已數千里，而覆敗於此百里間，良為可惜。

translations.literal: All transport from the various circuits, crossing lakes and traveling rivers, has already gone several thousand li, yet is wrecked within this hundred li—a real pity.
translations.idiomatic: Goods travel thousands of li across lakes and rivers from every circuit, only to be wrecked in this final hundred li—a grievous waste.

sentences.zh: 宜自龜山蛇浦下屬洪澤，鑿左肋為復河，取淮為源，不置堰閘，可免風濤覆溺之患。

translations.literal: It is fitting from Guishan and Shepu downstream to Hongze to cut the left flank as a return river, taking the Huai as source, setting up no barrages or gates, so as to avoid the affliction of wind and waves and foundering.
translations.idiomatic: We should cut a return channel along the left bank from Guishan and Shepu down to Hongze, drawing water from the Huai without barrages or gates, to escape wind, waves, and sinking.

sentences.zh: 」帝遣都水監丞陳祐甫經度。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Chen Youfu, assistant director of the Directorate of Waterways, to plan the project.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Chen Youfu, assistant director of the Directorate of Waterways, to oversee planning.

sentences.zh: 祐甫言：「往年田棐任淮南提刑，嘗言開河之利。

translations.literal: Youfu said: "In former years when Tian Fei served as Huainan judicial intendant, he once spoke of the benefit of opening a river."
translations.idiomatic: Youfu reported: "Years ago, when Tian Fei served as Huainan judicial intendant, he spoke of the benefits of opening such a channel."

sentences.zh: 其後淮陰至洪澤，竟開新河，獨洪澤以上，未克興役。

translations.literal: Afterward from Huaiyin to Hongze they finally opened a new river, but only above Hongze they could not undertake the labor.
translations.idiomatic: A new channel from Huaiyin to Hongze was eventually completed, but the section above Hongze was never undertaken.

sentences.zh: 今既不用閘蓄水，惟隨淮面高下，開深河底，引淮通流，形勢為便。

translations.literal: Now, since gates will not be used to store water, only following the rise and fall of the Huai surface, deepening the riverbed and drawing the Huai to flow through, the terrain is convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Since we need no gates to impound water, we need only follow the Huai's level, deepen the channel bed, and draw the river through—a favorable arrangement.

sentences.zh: 但工費浩大。

translations.literal: But the labor costs are vast.
translations.idiomatic: But the labor costs would be enormous.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「費雖大，利亦博矣。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Though the expense is great, the benefit is also broad."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The cost may be great, but the benefit is greater still."

sentences.zh: 」祐甫曰：「異時，淮中歲失百七十艘。

translations.literal: Youfu said: "In other times, on the Huai each year one hundred seventy vessels were lost."
translations.idiomatic: Youfu replied: "In past years as many as one hundred seventy vessels were lost on the Huai each year."

sentences.zh: 若捐數年所損之費，足濟此役。

translations.literal: If one gave up the losses of several years, it would suffice to fund this project.
translations.idiomatic: The losses of just a few years would more than pay for the project.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「損費尚小，如人命何。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Material loss is still small—what of human lives?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Material loss is a lesser matter—what of human lives?"

sentences.zh: 」乃調夫十萬開治，既成，命之奇撰記，刻石龜山，後至建中靖國初，之奇同知樞密院，奏：「淮水浸淫，沖刷堤岸，漸成墊缺，請下發運司及時修築。

translations.literal: Thereupon one hundred thousand laborers were mobilized to open and manage [the canal]; when it was completed, Zhiqi was ordered to compose a record and carve it on stone at Guishan. Later, at the beginning of Jianzhong Jingguo, Zhiqi as vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized: "The Huai water seeps and spreads, scouring the dikes, gradually forming sunken breaches; I request the transport office be ordered to repair in timely fashion."
translations.idiomatic: One hundred thousand laborers were mobilized for the work. When it was finished, Zhiqi was ordered to compose a commemorative inscription and carve it on stone at Guishan. Later, at the beginning of Jianzhong Jingguo, Zhiqi, now vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, memorialized: "Huai floodwaters are seeping and scouring the dikes into sunken breaches. I ask that the transport office be ordered to repair them promptly."

sentences.zh: 」自是，歲以為常。

translations.literal: From this time forth, it became an annual routine.
translations.idiomatic: From then on this became an annual obligation.

sentences.zh: 是年，將作監主簿李湜言：「鼎、澧等州，宜開溝洫，置斗門，以便民田。

translations.literal: That year, Li Chen, registrar of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, said: "In Ding, Li, and other prefectures, it is fitting to open ditches and canals and set up sluice gates to benefit the people's fields."
translations.idiomatic: That year Li Chen, registrar of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, reported: "In Ding, Li, and other prefectures, ditches and canals should be opened and sluice gates installed to benefit farmland."

sentences.zh: 」詔措置以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered arrangements to be made and reported.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered plans to be drawn up and reported back.

sentences.zh: 七年十月，浚真、楚運河。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the seventh year, the transport canals of Zhen and Chu were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the seventh year, the transport canals at Zhen and Chu were dredged.

sentences.zh: 哲宗元祐四年，知潤州林希奏復呂城堰，置上下閘，以時啟閉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanyou under Emperor Zhezong, Lin Xi, prefect of Runzhou, memorialized to restore the Lücheng barrage, setting upper and lower gates to open and close at the proper times.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yuanyou, Lin Xi, governor of Run Prefecture, petitioned to restore the Lücheng barrage with upper and lower gates opened and closed on schedule.

sentences.zh: 其後，京口、瓜州、奔牛皆置閘。

translations.literal: Afterward, Jingkou, Guazhou, and Benniu all had gates installed.
translations.idiomatic: Gates were subsequently installed at Jingkou, Guazhou, and Benniu as well.

sentences.zh: 是歲，知杭州蘇軾浚茆山、鹽橋二河，分受江潮及西湖水，造堰閘，以時啟閉。

translations.literal: That year, Su Shi, prefect of Hangzhou, dredged the Mao Mountain and Salt Bridge rivers, dividing them to receive river tides and West Lake water, building barrages and gates to open and close at the proper times.
translations.idiomatic: That year Su Shi, governor of Hangzhou, dredged the Mao Mountain and Salt Bridge rivers to receive both tidal water from the river and water from West Lake, building barrages and gates operated on schedule.

sentences.zh: 初，杭近海，患水泉咸苦，唐刺史李泌始導西湖，作六井，民以足用。

translations.literal: Formerly, Hang was near the sea and troubled by brackish, bitter springs; Tang prefect Li Bi first led in West Lake water and made six wells, so the people had enough to use.
translations.idiomatic: Long ago Hangzhou lay near the sea, and its springs ran brackish and bitter. Tang prefect Li Bi first channeled West Lake water and dug six wells, giving the people an adequate supply.

sentences.zh: 及白居易復浚西湖，引水入運河，復引溉田千頃。

translations.literal: When Bai Juyi again dredged West Lake, he led water into the transport canal and again led it to irrigate a thousand qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Juyi later dredged West Lake again, channeling its water into the transport canal and irrigating a thousand qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 湖水多葑，自唐及錢氏後廢而不理。

translations.literal: The lake water had much duckweed; from the Tang through the Qian clan it was abandoned and not managed.
translations.idiomatic: Duckweed choked the lake; from the Tang through the Qian kingdom it was neglected.

sentences.zh: 至是，葑積二十五萬餘丈，而水無幾。

translations.literal: By this time duckweed had accumulated more than two hundred fifty thousand zhang, and there was little water.
translations.idiomatic: By now duckweed had piled up to more than two hundred fifty thousand zhang, leaving scarcely any open water.

sentences.zh: 運河失湖水之利，取給于江潮，潮水淤河，泛溢闤闠，三年一浚，為市井大患，故六井亦幾廢。

translations.literal: The transport canal lost the benefit of lake water and drew supply from river tides; tidal water silted the river, overflowed the markets, and required dredging every three years—a great affliction for the city, so the six wells also nearly fell into disuse.
translations.idiomatic: The transport canal lost West Lake's benefits and relied on tidal water instead. Tides silted the canal, flooded the markets, and required dredging every three years—a constant plague on the city—so the six wells nearly fell into disuse as well.

sentences.zh: 軾既浚二河，復以餘力全六井，民獲其利。

translations.literal: After Shi had dredged the two rivers, he again with remaining effort restored the six wells, and the people obtained the benefit.
translations.idiomatic: After dredging the two rivers, Su Shi used the remaining labor to restore all six wells, to the people's great benefit.

sentences.zh: 十二月，京東轉運司言：「清河與江、浙、淮南諸路相通，因徐州呂梁、百步兩洪湍淺險惡，多壞舟楫，由是水手、牛驢、扌牽戶、盤剝人等，邀阻百端，商賈不行。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Jingdong transport office said: "The Qing River connects with the Jiang, Zhe, and Huainan circuits, but because at Xuzhou the Lüliang and Baibu rapids are turbulent, shallow, perilous, and vicious, many boats are ruined; thereby boatmen, oxen and donkeys, haulers, and extortionists obstruct in countless ways, and merchants do not travel."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Jingdong transport office reported: "The Qing River links the Jiang, Zhe, and Huainan circuits, but at Xuzhou the Lüliang and Baibu rapids are treacherous, shallow, and violent, wrecking countless vessels. Boatmen, haulers, ox-drivers, and extortionists exploit every obstruction, and merchants refuse to travel the route."

sentences.zh: 朝廷已委齊州通判滕希靖、知常州晉陵縣趙竦度地勢穿鑿。

translations.literal: The court has already entrusted Teng Xijing, vice-prefect of Qizhou, and Zhao Song, magistrate of Jinling County in Changzhou, to survey the terrain and cut through.
translations.idiomatic: The court has already assigned Teng Xijing, vice-prefect of Qi Prefecture, and Zhao Song, magistrate of Jinling County in Changzhou, to survey the terrain and cut a channel.

sentences.zh: 今若開修月河石堤，上下置閘，以時開閉，通放舟船，實為長利。

translations.literal: Now if we open and repair a moon-river with stone dikes, setting upper and lower gates to open and close at the proper times and release boats to pass, it would truly be a lasting benefit.
translations.idiomatic: If we now open a bypass channel with stone dikes and upper and lower gates operated on schedule, vessels could pass freely—a lasting benefit.

sentences.zh: 乞遣使監督興修。

translations.literal: I beg that an envoy be sent to supervise the undertaking.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that an envoy be dispatched to supervise construction.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 紹聖二年，詔「武進、丹陽、丹徒縣界沿河堤岸及石鹈達、石木溝，並委令佐檢察修護，勸誘食利人戶修葺。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaosheng, an edict [said]: "The river dikes along the boundaries of Wujin, Danyang, and Dantu counties and the Shitida and Shimugou [works] are all entrusted to magistrates and assistants to inspect and maintain, encouraging profit-seeking households to repair."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shaosheng an edict decreed: "River dikes along the boundaries of Wujin, Danyang, and Dantu counties, and the Shitida and Shimugou works, shall be inspected and maintained by local magistrates and assistants, who shall encourage households that profit from the waterways to carry out repairs."

sentences.zh: 任滿，稽其勤惰而賞罰之。

translations.literal: When their terms expire, examine their diligence and sloth and reward or punish them.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of their terms, their diligence or neglect shall be assessed and rewarded or punished accordingly.

sentences.zh: 」從工部之請也。

translations.literal: This followed a request from the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: This followed a petition from the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，水部員外郎趙竦請浚十八里河，令賈種民相度呂梁、百步洪，添移水磨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year, Zhao Song, outer vice director of the Water Bureau, requested dredging the Eighteen-li River and ordered Jia Zhongmin to survey the Lüliang and Baibu rapids and relocate water mills.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year, Zhao Song of the Water Bureau petitioned to dredge the Eighteen-li River and ordered Jia Zhongmin to survey the Lüliang and Baibu rapids and relocate water mills.

sentences.zh: 詔發運並轉運司同視利害以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the transport commissioner and circuit transport offices jointly to view the benefits and harms and report.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the transport commissioner and circuit transport offices jointly to assess costs and benefits and report back.

sentences.zh: 元符元年正月，知潤州王悆建言：「呂城閘常宜單水入澳，灌注閘身以濟舟。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yuanfu, Wang Yu, prefect of Runzhou, submitted a proposal: "At the Lücheng gate, a single stream should regularly be led into the basin to fill the gate structure and assist boats."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Yuanfu, Wang Yu, governor of Run Prefecture, proposed: "At the Lücheng lock, a steady stream should be channeled into the basin to fill the lock chamber and assist passing vessels."

sentences.zh: 若舟遝至而力不給，許量差牽駕兵卒，並力為之。

translations.literal: If boats arrive in a crowd and strength is insufficient, permit temporarily assigning hauling soldiers to work together.
translations.idiomatic: If vessels arrive in numbers beyond local capacity, hauling soldiers may be temporarily assigned to assist.

sentences.zh: 監官任滿，水無走泄者賞，水未應而輒開閘者罰，守貳、令佐，常覺察之。

translations.literal: When supervising officials complete their terms, those with no water leakage are rewarded; those who open the gates when water is not ready are punished; prefectural deputies and magistrates shall regularly oversee this.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising officials who complete their terms without water leakage shall be rewarded; those who open the gates prematurely shall be punished. Prefectural deputies and magistrates shall oversee this regularly.

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: An edict approved [this].
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，工部言：「淮南開河所開修楚州支家河，導漣水與淮通。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the third month, the Ministry of Works said: "The Huainan river-opening office has opened and repaired the Zhijia River in Chuzhou, leading Lianshui water to connect with the Huai."
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day in the third month the Ministry of Works reported: "The Huainan river-opening office has completed the Zhijia River in Chuzhou, connecting Lianshui water with the Huai."

sentences.zh: 」賜名通漣河。

translations.literal: It was granted the name Tonglian River.
translations.idiomatic: It was given the name Tonglian River (River Connecting to Lianshui).

sentences.zh: 二年閏九月，潤州京口、常州奔牛澳閘畢工。

translations.literal: In the intercalary ninth month of the second year, the basin gates of Jingkou in Runzhou and Benniu in Changzhou were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month of the second year, the basin locks at Jingkou in Run Prefecture and Benniu in Chang Prefecture were completed.

sentences.zh: 先是，兩浙轉運判官曾孝蘊獻澳閘利害，因命孝蘊提舉興修，仍相度立啟閉日限之法。

translations.literal: Earlier, Zeng Xiaoyun, transport vice-commissioner of the two Zhe circuits, presented the benefits and harms of basin gates; he was therefore ordered to take charge of construction and also to survey and establish regulations for the time limits of opening and closing.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Zeng Xiaoyun, transport vice-commissioner for the two Zhe circuits, had presented an analysis of basin-lock benefits and costs. He was placed in charge of construction and directed to establish regulations governing when the locks should open and close.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，詔：「蘇、湖、秀州，凡開治運河、港浦、溝瀆，修壘堤岸，開置斗門、水堰等，許役開江兵卒。」

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, an edict said: "In Su, Hu, and Xiu prefectures, for all opening and managing of transport canals, harbors, and ditches, repairing dikes and banks, and establishing sluice gates and water barrages, the use of river-opening troops is permitted."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year an edict declared: "In Suzhou, Huzhou, and Xiuzhou, for all work on transport canals, harbors, ditches, dikes, sluice gates, and water barrages, river-opening troops may be employed."

sentences.zh: 徽宗崇甯元年十二月，置提舉淮、浙澳閘司官一員，掌杭州至揚州瓜洲澳閘，凡常、潤、杭、秀、揚州新舊等閘，通治之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Chongning under Emperor Huizong, one post of commissioner for Huai-Zhe basin gates was established, in charge of basin gates from Hangzhou to Guazhou in Yangzhou—all old and new gates of Chang, Run, Hang, Xiu, and Yang prefectures—governing them comprehensively.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Chongning, Emperor Huizong created the post of commissioner for Huai-Zhe basin locks, overseeing all locks from Hangzhou to Guazhou in Yangzhou—including old and new locks in Chang, Run, Hang, Xiu, and Yang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 崇寧二年初，通直郎陳仲方別議浚吳松江，自大通浦入海，計工二百二十二萬七千有奇，為緡錢、糧斛十八萬三千六百，乞置幹當官十員。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the second year of Chongning, Chen Zhongfang, gentleman for direct remonstrance, separately proposed dredging the Wusong River from Datong Creek to the sea, estimating labor at more than two million two hundred twenty-seven thousand [units], costing cash and grain rations of one hundred eighty-three thousand six hundred, and requesting ten managing officials.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the second year of Chongning, Chen Zhongfang proposed dredging the Wusong River from Datong Creek to the sea, estimating more than 2.227 million labor units at a cost of 183,600 in cash and grain rations, and requesting ten supervising officials.

sentences.zh: 朝廷下兩浙監司詳議，監司以為可行。

translations.literal: The court sent [the proposal] down to the two Zhe supervisory officials for detailed deliberation; the supervisory officials judged it feasible.
translations.idiomatic: The court referred the proposal to supervisory officials in the two Zhe circuits, who judged it feasible.

sentences.zh: 時又開青龍江，役夫不勝其勞，而提舉常平徐確謂：「三州開江兵卒千四百人，使臣二人，請就令護察已開之江，遇潮沙淤澱，隨即開淘；

translations.literal: At the time the Qinglong River was also being opened; corvée laborers could not bear the toil, and Xu Que, commissioner for the Ever-Normal Granaries, said: "In the three prefectures there are one thousand four hundred river-opening troops and two envoys; I request they be ordered to guard and inspect the already opened river, and whenever tidal sand silts up, immediately dredge;
translations.idiomatic: The Qinglong River was also being opened at the time, and corvée laborers were overwhelmed. Xu Que, commissioner for the Ever-Normal Granaries, argued: "The three prefectures have 1,400 river-opening troops and two envoys. Let them guard the opened channels and dredge immediately whenever tidal sand silts them up;

sentences.zh: 若他役者，以違制論。

translations.literal: if [they are used] for other labor, they shall be prosecuted for violating regulations.
translations.idiomatic: any use of them for other duties shall be prosecuted as a violation of regulations.

sentences.zh: 」確與監司往往被賞，人以為濫。

translations.literal: Que and the supervisory officials were often rewarded, and people considered it excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Que and the supervisory officials were repeatedly rewarded, which many regarded as excessive.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔淮南開修遇明河，自真州宣化鎮江口至泗州淮河口，五年畢工。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, an edict [ordered] Huainan to open and repair the Yuming River from the river mouth at Xuanhua Town in Zhenzhou to the Huai estuary in Sizhou, to be completed in five years.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict ordered Huainan to open the Yuming River from the river mouth at Xuanhua Town in Zhen Prefecture to the Huai estuary at Si Prefecture, with completion in five years.

sentences.zh: 明年三月，詔曰：「昨二浙水災，委官調夫開江，而總領無法，役人暴露，飲食失所，疾病死亡者眾。

translations.literal: In the third month of the next year, an edict said: "Last year in the two Zhe circuits there was a flood disaster; officials were entrusted to mobilize laborers to open rivers, but overall direction had no method; laborers were exposed [to the elements], lost proper food and drink, and many fell ill and died."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the following year an edict declared: "Last year's floods in the two Zhe circuits led officials to mobilize laborers for river works, but there was no effective leadership. Laborers were left exposed, without adequate food or shelter, and many fell ill and died."

sentences.zh: 水仍為害，未嘗究實按罪，反蒙推賞，何以厭塞百姓怨咨。

translations.literal: The water still caused harm; there was never a thorough investigation and assignment of guilt, yet [they] instead received promotions and rewards—how can the people's complaints and resentments be satisfied?
translations.idiomatic: Flooding continued unabated, yet no one was held accountable—instead officials were promoted and rewarded. How can this satisfy the people's outrage?"

sentences.zh: 」乃下本路提刑司體量。

translations.literal: Thereupon the circuit judicial intendant's office of this circuit was ordered to investigate on site.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit judicial intendant's office was ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 提刑司言：「開浚吳松、青龍江，役夫五萬，死者千一百六十二人，費錢米十六萬九千三百四十一貫石，積水至今未退。

translations.literal: The judicial intendant's office said: "In opening and dredging the Wusong and Qinglong rivers, fifty thousand laborers [were used]; the dead numbered one thousand one hundred sixty-two; expenses in cash and grain were one hundred sixty-nine thousand three hundred forty-one guan and shi; accumulated water to this day has not receded."
translations.idiomatic: The judicial intendant's office reported: "Dredging the Wusong and Qinglong rivers employed fifty thousand laborers. One thousand one hundred sixty-two died. Costs reached 169,341 guan and shi in cash and grain. Floodwaters have still not receded."

sentences.zh: 」於是元相度官轉運副使劉何等皆坐貶降。

translations.literal: Thereupon the former survey officials, transport vice-commissioner Liu He and others, all suffered demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the former planning officials, including transport vice-commissioner Liu He, were all demoted.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，以倉部員外郎沈延嗣提舉開修青草、洞庭直河。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, Shen Yansi, outer vice director of the Granary Bureau, was appointed to take charge of opening and repairing the Qingcao and Dongting direct rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, Shen Yansi of the Granary Bureau was appointed to oversee opening the Qingcao and Dongting direct channels.

sentences.zh: 大觀元年五月，中書舍人許光凝奏：「臣向在姑蘇，遍詢民吏，皆謂欲去水患，莫若開江浚浦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Daguan, Xu Guangning, drafting secretary of the Secretariat, memorialized: "When I was formerly in Gusu, I inquired widely among the people and officials; all said that to remove flood affliction, nothing is better than opening rivers and dredging creeks."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Daguan, Xu Guangning of the Secretariat reported: "During my time in Suzhou I questioned officials and commoners alike, and all agreed that the best way to end flooding is to open rivers and dredge creeks."

sentences.zh: 蓋太湖在諸郡間，必導之海然後水有所歸。

translations.literal: For Lake Tai lies among the various prefectures; it must be led to the sea before water has a place to go.
translations.idiomatic: Lake Tai lies among the prefectures; its waters must be channeled to the sea before they can drain away.

sentences.zh: 自太湖距海，有三江，有諸浦，能疏滌江、浦，除水患猶反掌耳。

translations.literal: From Lake Tai to the sea there are the Three Rivers and the various creeks; if one can clear and cleanse the rivers and creeks, removing flood affliction is like turning the palm.
translations.idiomatic: Between Lake Tai and the sea lie the Three Rivers and numerous creeks. Clear those channels and flood control becomes effortless.

sentences.zh: 今境內積水，視去歲損二尺，視前歲損四尺，良由初開吳松江，繼浚八浦之力也。

translations.literal: Now accumulated water within the territory is two chi less than last year and four chi less than the year before—truly owing to the power of first opening the Wusong River and then dredging the eight creeks.
translations.idiomatic: Flood levels within the region are two chi lower than last year and four chi lower than the year before—thanks to opening the Wusong River and dredging the eight creeks.

sentences.zh: 吳人謂開一江有一江之利，浚一浦有一浦之利。

translations.literal: The people of Wu say: open one river and there is one river's benefit; dredge one creek and there is one creek's benefit.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Wu say that every river opened brings its own benefit, and every creek dredged brings its own.

sentences.zh: 願委本路監司，與諳曉水勢精強之吏，遍詣江、浦，詳究利害，假以歲月，先為之備。

translations.literal: I wish the circuit supervisory officials of this circuit, together with capable officials versed in water conditions, to visit all rivers and creeks, examine benefits and harms in detail, be given time, and prepare in advance.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that circuit supervisory officials, together with capable officers who understand water conditions, visit every river and creek, study costs and benefits in detail, and prepare over time before work begins.

sentences.zh: 然後興夫調役，可使公無費財，而歲供常足；

translations.literal: Then when labor is mobilized, the state may spend no funds yet annual tribute be constantly sufficient;
translations.idiomatic: Then when labor is mobilized, the state need spend nothing while annual tribute remains secure;

sentences.zh: 人不告勞，而民食不匱，是一舉而獲萬世之利也。

translations.literal: people will not complain of toil, and the people's food will not be exhausted—one act gaining benefit for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: the people will not suffer undue hardship, and food supplies will not run short—a single undertaking bringing benefit for generations.

sentences.zh: 」詔吳擇仁相度以聞，開江之議復興矣。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wu Zeren to survey and report; the proposal to open rivers revived.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Wu Zeren to survey the project and report back, and the proposal to open rivers was revived.

sentences.zh: 十一月，詔曰：「《禹貢》：'三江既導，震澤底定。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, an edict said: "The Tribute of Yu says: 'The Three Rivers were led forth, and Lake Zhen was settled.'"
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month an edict declared: "The Tribute of Yu states: 'When the Three Rivers were led forth, Lake Zhen was settled.'"

sentences.zh: '今三江之名，既失其所，水不趨海，故蘇、湖被患。

translations.literal: Now the names of the Three Rivers have lost their places; water does not run to the sea, and therefore Su and Hu suffer affliction.
translations.idiomatic: Today the Three Rivers have lost their proper courses, water no longer reaches the sea, and Suzhou and Huzhou suffer flooding as a result.

sentences.zh: 其委本路監司，選擇能臣，檢按古跡，循導使之趨下，並相度圩岸以聞。

translations.literal: Entrust the circuit supervisory officials of this circuit to select capable ministers, inspect ancient traces, guide and lead [water] to run downward, and also survey polder dikes and report.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit supervisory officials shall select capable officers, inspect ancient waterways, guide the waters downward, survey polder dikes, and report back.

sentences.zh: 」於是復詔陳仲方為發運司屬官，再相度蘇州積水。

translations.literal: Thereupon Chen Zhongfang was again ordered as an official of the transport commission to survey once more the accumulated water of Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhongfang was then reappointed as an official of the transport commission to survey Suzhou's floodwaters again.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，詔：「常、潤歲旱河淺，留滯運船，監司督責浚治。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year, an edict said: "Chang and Run each year suffer drought and shallow rivers, delaying transport boats; supervisory officials shall supervise and demand dredging."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year an edict declared: "Chang and Run suffer drought and shallow rivers each year, delaying transport vessels. Supervisory officials shall oversee dredging."

sentences.zh: 」三年，兩浙監司言：「承詔案古跡，導積水，今請開淘吳松江，復置十二閘。

translations.literal: In the third year, the two Zhe supervisory officials said: "In accordance with the edict we have investigated ancient traces and led off accumulated water; now we request to open and dredge the Wusong River and restore twelve gates."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the two Zhe supervisory officials reported: "Following the edict we have surveyed ancient waterways and drained floodwaters. We now request dredging the Wusong River and restoring twelve locks."

sentences.zh: 其餘浦閘、溝港、運河之類，以次增修。

translations.literal: The remaining creek gates, ditch harbors, transport canals, and the like shall be incrementally repaired in order.
translations.idiomatic: Other creek locks, harbors, ditches, and transport canals shall be repaired in sequence.

sentences.zh: 若田被水圍，勸民自行修治。

translations.literal: Where fields are surrounded by water, encourage the people to repair on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Where fields are flooded, encourage the people to undertake repairs themselves.

sentences.zh: 」章下工部，工部謂：「今所具三江，或非禹跡；

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down to the Ministry of Works, which said: "The Three Rivers now presented may not be traces of Yu;"
translations.idiomatic: The memorial went to the Ministry of Works, which replied: "The Three Rivers now proposed may not be Yu's original waterways;"

sentences.zh: 又吳松江散漫，不可開淘泄水。

translations.literal: moreover the Wusong River is diffuse and scattered and cannot be opened and dredged to discharge water.
translations.idiomatic: moreover the Wusong River is too diffuse to be dredged effectively for drainage.

sentences.zh: 」遂命諸司再相度以聞。

translations.literal: Thereupon all offices were ordered to survey again and report.
translations.idiomatic: All relevant offices were then ordered to survey again and report back.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，臣僚言：「有司以練湖賜茅山道觀，緣潤州田多高仰，及運渠、夾岡水淺易涸，賴湖以濟，請別用天荒江漲沙田賜之，仍令提舉常平官考求前人規畫修築。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year, a courtier said: "The authorities have granted Lian Lake to the Maoshan Daoist abbey. Because Runzhou fields are mostly high-lying, and the transport canal and the water between ridges are shallow and easily dry, they rely on the lake for relief. I request that wilderness sand fields from river floods be used instead for the grant, and that the commissioner for the Ever-Normal Granaries investigate former people's plans for repair and construction."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year a courtier reported: "Officials have granted Lian Lake to the Maoshan Daoist abbey. Run Prefecture's fields lie mostly on high ground, and the transport canal and inter-ridge waters run shallow and dry easily—the region depends on the lake. Grant wilderness sand flats from river floods instead, and direct the Ever-Normal commissioner to study earlier plans for repair and construction."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十月，戶部言：「乞如兩浙常平司奏，專委守、令籍古瀦水之地，立堤防之限，俾公私毋得侵佔。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Ministry of Revenue said: "I beg, as the two Zhe Ever-Normal office memorialized, to entrust prefects and magistrates to register ancient water-storage lands, establish limits for dikes and defenses, and cause public and private [parties] not to encroach."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Ministry of Revenue petitioned: "As the two Zhe Ever-Normal office proposed, prefects and magistrates should register ancient water-storage lands, set limits on dikes and defenses, and prohibit public or private encroachment."

sentences.zh: 凡民田不近水者，略仿《周官》遂人、稻人溝防之制，使合眾力而為之。

translations.literal: For all people's fields not near water, roughly imitate the ditch-defense system of the suiren and daoren in the Offices of Zhou, causing the combined strength of the multitude to do it.
translations.idiomatic: For farmland far from water, follow roughly the ditch and dike system of the Zhou Offices, mobilizing collective labor.

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: An edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 政和元年十月，詔蘇、湖、秀三州治水，創立圩岸，其工費許給越州鑒湖租賦。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Zhenghe, an edict [ordered] Su, Hu, and Xiu three prefectures to manage water, establish polder dikes, and permitted labor costs to be supplied from the rent and levies of Jian Lake in Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Zhenghe an edict ordered Suzhou, Huzhou, and Xiuzhou to manage floodwaters and build polder dikes, with labor costs drawn from Jian Lake rents in Yue Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 已而升蘇州為平江府，潤州為鎮江府。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward Suzhou was promoted to Pingjiang Prefecture and Runzhou to Zhenjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou was soon elevated to Pingjiang Prefecture and Runzhou to Zhenjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二年七月，兵部尚書張閣言：「臣昨守杭州，聞錢塘江自元豐六年泛溢之後，潮訊往來，率無寧歲。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year, Zhang Ge, minister of the Ministry of War, said: "When I was formerly defending Hangzhou, I heard that since the Qiantang River overflowed in the sixth year of Yuanfeng, tidal surges coming and going have generally known no peaceful year."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year Zhang Ge, minister of war, reported: "When I governed Hangzhou, I learned that since the Qiantang River flooded in the sixth year of Yuanfeng, tidal surges have brought scarcely a peaceful year."

sentences.zh: 而比年水勢稍改，自海門過赭山，即回薄岩門、白石一帶北岸，壞民田及鹽亭、監地，東西三十餘里，南北二十餘里。

translations.literal: But in recent years the water force has slightly changed; from Haimen passing Zhe Mountain, it turns back against the north bank of the Yanmen and Baishi stretch, ruining the people's fields and salt pavilions and supervisory lands, more than thirty li east-west and more than twenty li north-south.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the current has shifted. From Haimen past Zhe Mountain it now strikes the north bank at Yanmen and Baishi, destroying farmland and salt works over thirty li east to west and twenty li north to south.

sentences.zh: 江東距仁和監止及三里，北趣赤岸口二十里。

translations.literal: East of the river, the distance to Renhe Salt Office is barely three li; north toward Chi'an mouth is twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: East of the river, Renhe Salt Office lies barely three li away; Chi'an mouth is twenty li to the north.

sentences.zh: 運河正出臨平下塘，西入蘇、秀，若失障禦，恐他日數十里膏腴平陸，皆潰于江，下塘田廬，莫能自保，運河中絕，有害漕運。

translations.literal: The transport canal runs straight out from Linping Xiatang west into Su and Xiu; if protective barriers are lost, I fear that in future several tens of li of fertile level land will all collapse into the river, the fields and houses of Xiatang will be unable to protect themselves, the transport canal will be cut off, and grain transport will be harmed.
translations.idiomatic: The transport canal runs from Linping Xiatang west into Suzhou and Xiuzhou. Without protective barriers, tens of li of fertile lowland could be swallowed by the river, Xiatang's farms and homes would be lost, the canal cut off, and grain transport ruined.

sentences.zh: 」詔亟修築之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered urgent repair and construction.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered immediate repairs.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，工部言：「前太平州判官盧宗原請開修自江州至真州古來河道湮塞者凡七處，以成運河，入浙西一百五十里，可避一千六百里大江風濤之患；

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, the Ministry of Works said: "Formerly Lu Zongyuan, vice-prefect of Taiping Prefecture, requested to open and repair seven places where ancient river channels from Jiangzhou to Zhenzhou were silted up, to complete a transport canal entering western Zhe one hundred fifty li, avoiding the affliction of wind and waves on the great river for one thousand six hundred li;"
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year the Ministry of Works reported: "Former Taiping vice-prefect Lu Zongyuan proposed reopening seven silted ancient channels from Jiang Prefecture to Zhen Prefecture to form a transport canal 150 li into western Zhe, bypassing 1,600 li of dangerous river winds and waves;"

sentences.zh: 又可就土興築自古江水浸沒膏腴田，自三百頃至萬頃者凡九所，計四萬二千餘頃，其三百頃以下者又過之。

translations.literal: one could also use the earth to build up fertile fields long inundated by river water, nine places from three hundred to ten thousand qing, totaling more than forty-two thousand qing, and those below three hundred qing exceed this further.
translations.idiomatic: excavated earth could also reclaim fertile fields long submerged by the river—nine sites ranging from 300 to 10,000 qing, totaling over 42,000 qing, with many smaller plots besides.

sentences.zh: 乞依宗原任太平州判官日已興政和圩田例，召人戶自備財力興修。

translations.literal: I beg to follow the precedent of polder fields established in Zhenghe when Zongyuan was vice-prefect of Taiping, summoning households to supply their own funds and labor for construction.
translations.idiomatic: Following the polder precedent from Zongyuan's tenure in Taiping, households should be invited to supply their own funds and labor.

sentences.zh: 」詔沈鏻等相度措置。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Shen Lin and others to survey and arrange matters.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Lin and others were ordered to survey and arrange the project.

sentences.zh: 六年閏正月，知杭州李偃言：「湯村、岩門、白石等處並錢塘江通大海，日受兩潮，漸至侵齧。

translations.literal: In the intercalary first month of the sixth year, Li Yan, prefect of Hangzhou, said: "Tang Village, Yanmen, Baishi, and other places all connect with the Qiantang River to the great sea, daily receiving two tides, gradually coming to encroach and gnaw."
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary first month of the sixth year Li Yan, governor of Hangzhou, reported: "Tang Village, Yanmen, Baishi, and other sites along the Qiantang River open to the sea receive two tides daily and are being steadily eroded."

sentences.zh: 乞依六和寺岸，用石砌疊。

translations.literal: I beg to follow the Liuhe Temple bank and use stone laid in courses.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the banks be faced with stone courses, as at Liuhe Temple.

sentences.zh: 」乃命劉既濟修治。

translations.literal: Liu Jiji was thereupon ordered to repair and manage [the works].
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jiji was ordered to carry out the repairs.

sentences.zh: 八月，詔：「鎮江府傍臨大江，無港澳以容舟檝，三年間覆溺五百餘艘。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, an edict said: "Zhenjiang Prefecture lies beside the great river with no harbor basin to hold boats; in three years more than five hundred vessels were wrecked and drowned."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month an edict declared: "Zhenjiang Prefecture lies on the great river without a harbor to shelter vessels. In three years more than five hundred boats have been lost."

sentences.zh: 聞西有舊河，可避風濤，歲久湮廢，宜令發運司浚治。」

translations.literal: I hear that to the west is an old river that can avoid wind and waves; long years have silted and abandoned it—it is fitting to order the transport commission to dredge and manage it."
translations.idiomatic: An old channel to the west could shelter boats from wind and waves, but it has long been abandoned. The transport commission should dredge it."

sentences.zh: 是年，詔曰：「聞平江三十六浦內，自昔置閘，隨潮啟閉，歲久堙塞，致積水為患。

translations.literal: That year, an edict said: "I hear that among the thirty-six creeks of Pingjiang, gates were placed from old times, opened and closed with the tides; after long years they were silted and blocked, causing accumulated water to become an affliction."
translations.idiomatic: That year an edict declared: "Among Pingjiang's thirty-six creeks, locks were installed long ago and opened and closed with the tides. Over the years they silted up, causing flooding."

sentences.zh: 其令守臣莊徽專委戶曹趙霖講究利害，導歸江海，依舊置閘。

translations.literal: Let the defending minister Zhuang Hui specially entrust Zhao Lin of the household bureau to investigate benefits and harms, lead [water] back to river and sea, and restore gates as before.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Zhuang Hui shall assign Zhao Lin of the household bureau to study costs and benefits, channel the waters back to the rivers and sea, and restore the locks.

sentences.zh: 」於是，發運副使應安道言：「凡港浦非要切者，皆可徐議。

translations.literal: Thereupon transport vice-commissioner Ying Andao said: "All harbors and creeks that are not critical may be discussed slowly.
translations.idiomatic: Transport vice-commissioner Ying Andao then reported: "Nonessential harbors and creeks can be discussed later.

sentences.zh: 惟當先開昆山縣界茜涇塘等六所；

translations.literal: Only the six places such as Qianjing Pond on the Kunshan county border should be opened first;
translations.idiomatic: Only six sites such as Qianjing Pond on the Kunshan border should be opened first;

sentences.zh: 秀之華亭縣，欲並循古法，盡去諸堰，各置小斗門；

translations.literal: in Huating County of Xiu, it is desired also to follow ancient methods, entirely remove all barrages, and at each place set small sluice gates;
translations.idiomatic: in Huating County, Xiuzhou, follow the ancient method: remove all barrages and install small sluice gates at each site;

sentences.zh: 常州、鎮江府、望亭鎮，仍舊置閘。

translations.literal: Changzhou, Zhenjiang Prefecture, and Wangting Town shall still set gates as before.
translations.idiomatic: Changzhou, Zhenjiang Prefecture, and Wangting Town shall retain their existing locks.

sentences.zh: 」八月，詔戶曹趙霖相度役興，而兩浙擾甚。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, an edict ordered Zhao Lin of the household bureau to survey the mobilization of labor, but the two Zhe circuits were greatly disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zhao Lin was ordered to survey labor mobilization, but the two Zhe circuits were in great turmoil.

sentences.zh: 七年四月己未，尚書省言：「盧宗原浚江，慮成搔擾。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the fourth month of the seventh year, the Secretariat said: "Lu Zongyuan's river dredging—I fear it will become disturbance."
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day in the fourth month of the seventh year the Secretariat reported: "Lu Zongyuan's river dredging risks causing widespread disruption."

sentences.zh: 」詔權罷其役，趙霖別與差遣。

translations.literal: An edict temporarily halted his labor; Zhao Lin was given a separate assignment.
translations.idiomatic: The work was temporarily suspended, and Zhao Lin was reassigned.

sentences.zh: 宣和元年二月，臣僚言：「江、淮、荊、漢間，荒瘠彌望，率古人一畝十鐘之地，其堤閼、水門、溝澮之跡猶存。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Xuanhe, a courtier said: "Between the Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Han, barren waste stretches as far as the eye can see—mostly land that in antiquity yielded ten zhong per mu; traces of dikes, water gates, and ditches still remain."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Xuanhe a courtier reported: "Between the Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Han, wasteland stretches everywhere—land that once yielded ten zhong per mu. Traces of dikes, water gates, and ditches still survive."

sentences.zh: 近絳州民呂平等詣御史台訴，乞開浚熙甯舊渠，以廣浸灌，願加稅一等。

translations.literal: Recently the people Lü Ping and others of Jiangzhou went to the Censorate to petition, begging to open and dredge the old canals of Xining to broaden irrigation, willing to pay one grade higher tax.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Lü Ping and others of Jiang Prefecture petitioned the Censorate to reopen Xining-era canals for broader irrigation, offering to pay one grade higher in taxes.

sentences.zh: 則是近世陂池之利且廢矣，何暇復古哉。

translations.literal: Thus even the benefits of ponds and reservoirs in recent times are about to be abandoned—what leisure to restore antiquity?
translations.idiomatic: Even recent pond and reservoir benefits are being abandoned—how can we hope to restore the ancients' methods?

sentences.zh: 願詔常平官，有興修水利功效明白者，亟以名聞，特與褒除，以勵能者。

translations.literal: I wish an edict to Ever-Normal officials: those with clear achievement in undertaking water conservancy should quickly have their names reported, be specially commended and promoted, to encourage the capable.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Ever-Normal officials report promptly the names of those with clear achievements in waterworks, that they receive special commendation and promotion to encourage capable men.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 八月，提舉專切措置水利農田所奏：「浙西諸縣各有陂湖、溝港、涇浜、湖濼，自來蓄水灌溉，及通舟楫，望令打量官按其地名、丈尺、四至，並鐫之石。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the office for special management of water conservancy and farmland memorialized: "The various counties of western Zhe each have ponds, lakes, ditch harbors, channels, and marshes that from old times store water for irrigation and also pass boats; I hope measuring officials may be ordered to record their place names, dimensions, and boundaries, and also carve them on stone."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the office for water conservancy and farmland reported: "Western Zhe counties each have ponds, lakes, harbors, channels, and marshes used for irrigation and navigation. Measuring officials should record their names, dimensions, and boundaries and inscribe them on stone."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 三月，趙霖坐增修水利不當，降兩官。

translations.literal: In the third month, Zhao Lin was demoted two ranks for improper additional water conservancy repairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Zhao Lin was demoted two ranks for mismanaging water conservancy repairs.

sentences.zh: 六月，詔曰：「趙霖興修水利，能募被水艱食之民，凡役工二百七十八萬二千四百有奇，開一江、一港、四浦、五十八瀆，已見成績，進直徽猷閣，仍復所降兩官。」

translations.literal: In the sixth month, an edict said: "Zhao Lin undertook water conservancy, able to recruit people afflicted by flood and hardship in food; labor totaled more than two million seven hundred eighty-two thousand four hundred; he opened one river, one harbor, four creeks, and fifty-eight channels, and achievement is already seen. He is advanced to direct attendant of the Huiyou Pavilion and his two demoted ranks are restored."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month an edict declared: "Zhao Lin undertook water conservancy, recruiting flood victims in distress. He mobilized over 2.782 million labor units, opening one river, one harbor, four creeks, and fifty-eight channels, with clear results. He is promoted to direct attendant of the Huiyou Pavilion and his two demoted ranks are restored."

sentences.zh: 宣和二年九月，以真、揚等州運河淺澀，委陳亨伯措置。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Xuanhe, because the transport canals of Zhen, Yang, and other prefectures were shallow and silted, Chen Hengbo was entrusted to arrange matters.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of Xuanhe, because transport canals in Zhen, Yang, and other prefectures had silted up, Chen Hengbo was assigned to address the problem.

sentences.zh: 三年春，詔發運副使趙億以車畎水運河，限三月中三十綱到京。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, an edict ordered transport vice-commissioner Zhao Yi to use cart-buckets to pour water into the transport canal, with a deadline that thirty convoys reach the capital by the third month.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year an edict ordered transport vice-commissioner Zhao Yi to use water wheels to fill the transport canal, with thirty convoys required to reach the capital by the third month.

sentences.zh: 宦者李琮言：「真州乃外江綱運會集要口，以運河淺澀，故不能速發。

translations.literal: The eunuch Li Cong said: "Zhenzhou is the critical junction where outer-river convoy transport gathers; because the transport canal is shallow and silted, [boats] therefore cannot depart quickly."
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Li Cong reported: "Zhen Prefecture is the critical junction where outer-river convoys gather. Because the transport canal is silted, vessels cannot depart promptly."

sentences.zh: 按南岸有泄水斗門八，去江不滿一里。

translations.literal: According to investigation, on the south bank there are eight drainage sluice gates, less than one li from the river.
translations.idiomatic: On the south bank are eight drainage sluice gates less than one li from the river.

sentences.zh: 欲開斗門河身，去江十丈築軟壩，引江潮入河，然後倍用人工車畎，以助運水。

translations.literal: I wish to open the sluice-gate river channel, build a soft dam ten zhang from the river, draw river tides into the canal, and then double the use of manual cart-buckets to assist transport water.
translations.idiomatic: I propose opening the sluice channel, building a soft dam ten zhang from the river to draw tidal water into the canal, then doubling manual water wheels to raise the water level for transport.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 四月，詔曰：「江、淮漕運尚矣。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, an edict said: "Jiang-Huai grain transport is of long standing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month an edict declared: "Jiang-Huai grain transport has a long history.

sentences.zh: 春秋時，吳穿邗溝，東北通射陽湖，西北至末口。

translations.literal: In Spring and Autumn times, Wu cut the Han Gou, northeast connecting to Sheyang Lake, northwest reaching Mokou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Spring and Autumn period Wu cut the Han Gou, connecting northeast to Sheyang Lake and northwest to Mokou.

sentences.zh: 漢吳王濞開邗溝，通運海陵。

translations.literal: In Han, King Pi of Wu opened the Han Gou, connecting transport to Hailing.
translations.idiomatic: Under Han, King Pi of Wu reopened the Han Gou to reach Hailing.

sentences.zh: 隋開邗溝，自山陽至揚子入江。

translations.literal: Sui opened the Han Gou from Shanyang to Yangzi entering the river.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui dynasty opened the Han Gou from Shanyang to Yangzi on the river.

sentences.zh: 雍熙中，轉運使劉蟠以山陽灣迅急，始開沙河以避險阻。

translations.literal: In Yongxi, transport commissioner Liu Pan, because Shanyang Bay was swift and urgent, first opened the Sha River to avoid perilous obstacles.
translations.idiomatic: During Yongxi, transport commissioner Liu Pan opened the Sha River to bypass the dangers of Shanyang Bay.

sentences.zh: 天禧中，發運使賈宗始開揚州古河，繚城南接運渠，毀三堰以均水勢。

translations.literal: In Tianxi, transport commissioner Jia Zong first opened Yangzhou's ancient river, winding around the south of the city to connect with the transport canal, destroying three barrages to equalize water level.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianxi, transport commissioner Jia Zong opened Yangzhou's ancient river around the south of the city to join the transport canal and demolished three barrages to even the water level.

sentences.zh: 今運河歲淺澀，當詢訪故道，及今河形勢與陂塘瀦水之地，講究措置悠久之利，以濟不通。

translations.literal: Now the transport canal each year is shallow and silted; one should inquire into old channels, and the present river's configuration and places of ponds and stored water, study and arrange lasting benefit, to remedy non-passage.
translations.idiomatic: Today the transport canal silts up yearly. Old channels, the present river's configuration, and pond and reservoir sites should be investigated to devise lasting solutions for the blockage.

sentences.zh: 可令發運使陳亨伯、內侍譚稹條具措置以聞。」

translations.literal: Transport commissioner Chen Hengbo and inner attendant Tan Zhen may be ordered to itemize arrangements and report."
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioner Chen Hengbo and inner attendant Tan Zhen shall itemize arrangements and report back."

sentences.zh: 八月，臣僚言：「比緣淮南運河水澀逾半歲，禁綱舟篙工附載私物，今河水增漲，其令如舊。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month, a courtier said: "Recently because Huainan transport canal water was shallow for more than half a year, convoy boat polemen were forbidden to carry private goods attached; now river water has risen—let the order be as before."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month a courtier reported: "Because the Huainan transport canal was shallow for more than half a year, convoy boatmen were forbidden to carry private cargo. Now that water levels have risen, restore the former regulations."

sentences.zh: 初，淮南連歲旱，漕運不通，揚州尤甚，詔中使按視，欲浚運河與江、淮平。

translations.literal: Earlier, Huainan suffered drought year after year; grain transport did not pass, Yangzhou especially so; an edict ordered an imperial envoy to inspect on site, wishing to dredge the transport canal level with the Jiang and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Huainan had suffered drought year after year, blocking grain transport—Yangzhou especially. An imperial envoy was sent to inspect and dredge the transport canal to the level of the Jiang and Huai.

sentences.zh: 會兩浙有方臘之亂，內侍童貫為宣撫使，譚稹為制置使，貫欲海運陸輦，稹欲開一河，自盱眙出宣化。

translations.literal: It happened that the two Zhe circuits had the Fang La rebellion; inner attendant Tong Guan was pacification commissioner and Tan Zhen disposition commissioner; Guan wished sea transport and land carriage, Zhen wished to open one river from Xuyi exiting at Xuanhua.
translations.idiomatic: The Fang La rebellion broke out in the two Zhe circuits. Eunuch Tong Guan served as pacification commissioner and Tan Zhen as disposition commissioner. Guan favored sea transport and overland carriage; Zhen proposed opening a channel from Xuyi to Xuanhua.

sentences.zh: 朝廷下發運司相度，陳亨伯遣其屬向子諲視之。

translations.literal: The court sent [the matter] down to the transport commission for survey; Chen Hengbo sent his subordinate Xiang Ziyin to inspect it.
translations.idiomatic: The court referred the matter to the transport commission for survey. Chen Hengbo sent his subordinate Xiang Ziyin to inspect the site.

sentences.zh: 子諲曰：「運河高江、淮數丈，自江至淮，凡數百里，人力難浚。

translations.literal: Ziyin said: "The transport canal is several zhang higher than the Jiang and Huai; from the river to the Huai is several hundred li—human strength can hardly dredge it."
translations.idiomatic: Ziyin reported: "The transport canal stands several zhang above the Jiang and Huai. From the river to the Huai is hundreds of li—manual dredging is impractical."

sentences.zh: 昔唐李吉甫廢閘置堰，治陂塘，泄有餘，防不足，漕運通流。

translations.literal: Formerly in Tang, Li Jifu abolished gates and set barrages, managed ponds and reservoirs, discharged surplus and guarded deficiency, and grain transport flowed through.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang times Li Jifu abolished gates, built barrages, managed ponds and reservoirs, discharged surplus water and conserved shortages, and grain transport flowed freely.

sentences.zh: 發運使曾孝蘊嚴三日一啟之制，復作歸水澳，惜水如金。

translations.literal: Transport commissioner Zeng Xiaoyun strictly enforced the system of opening once every three days, again made return-water basins, and treasured water like gold.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioner Zeng Xiaoyun strictly enforced opening locks every three days, rebuilt return-water basins, and conserved water like gold.

sentences.zh: 比年行直達之法，走茶鹽之利，且應奉權幸，朝夕經由，或啟或閉，不暇歸水。

translations.literal: In recent years the direct-transport method was practiced, pursuing tea and salt profits, and moreover serving powerful favorites passing through morning and evening, sometimes opening sometimes closing, with no leisure to return water.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years direct transport was instituted to pursue tea and salt profits. Powerful favorites passed through daily, opening and closing locks at will with no time to restore water levels.

sentences.zh: 又頃毀朝宗閘，自洪澤至召伯數百里，不為之節，故山陽上下不通。

translations.literal: Moreover the Chaozong gate was recently destroyed; from Hongze to Shaobo for several hundred li there was no regulation of it, and therefore above and below Shanyang did not connect.
translations.idiomatic: The Chaozong lock was recently destroyed. From Hongze to Shaobo, hundreds of li went unregulated, blocking passage above and below Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 欲救其弊，宜於真州太子港作一壩，以復懷子河故道，於瓜州河口作一壩，以復龍舟堰，於海陵河口作一壩，以復茱萸、待賢堰，使諸塘水不為瓜洲、真、泰三河所分，於北神相近作一壩，權閉滿浦閘，復朝宗閘，則上下無壅矣。

translations.literal: To remedy these ills, it is fitting at Taizi Harbor in Zhenzhou to make one dam to restore the old course of the Huaizi River; at Guazhou river mouth to make one dam to restore the Longzhou barrage; at Hailing river mouth to make one dam to restore the Zhuyu and Daixian barrages, so that the waters of the various ponds are not divided by the three rivers of Guazhou, Zhen, and Tai; near Beishen to make one dam, temporarily close the Manpu gate, restore the Chaozong gate—then above and below will have no obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: To remedy these ills: build a dam at Taizi Harbor in Zhen Prefecture to restore the Huaizi River's old course; a dam at Guazhou mouth to restore the Longzhou barrage; a dam at Hailing mouth to restore the Zhuyu and Daixian barrages, so pond waters are not divided among the Guazhou, Zhen, and Tai rivers; a dam near Beishen, temporarily closing Manpu lock and restoring Chaozong lock—then passage above and below will be unobstructed.

sentences.zh: 」亨伯用其言，是後滯舟皆通利雲。

translations.literal: Hengbo adopted his words; thereafter delayed boats all passed smoothly.
translations.idiomatic: Hengbo adopted his plan, and thereafter delayed vessels all passed smoothly.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，詔：「趙之鑒湖，明之廣德湖，自措置為田，下流堙塞，有妨灌溉，致失常賦，又多為權勢所占，兩州被害，民以流徙。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, an edict said: "Yue's Jian Lake and Ming's Guangde Lake, since being arranged as fields, downstream has been silted and blocked, hindering irrigation, causing loss of regular levies, and moreover much occupied by powerful interests—the two prefectures suffer harm and the people flee and migrate."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year an edict declared: "Yue's Jian Lake and Ming's Guangde Lake, since being converted to farmland, have silted downstream, hindering irrigation and disrupting regular tax revenues. Powerful interests have seized much of the land. Both prefectures suffer, and the people flee."

sentences.zh: 宜令陳亨伯究實，如租稅過重，即裁為中制；

translations.literal: Chen Hengbo should be ordered to investigate the facts; if rent and tax are too heavy, then reduce them to a moderate standard;
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hengbo shall investigate. If rents and taxes are excessive, reduce them to moderate levels;

sentences.zh: 應妨下流灌溉者，並馳以予民。」

translations.literal: whatever hinders downstream irrigation shall all be swiftly returned to the people."
translations.idiomatic: and whatever obstructs downstream irrigation shall be promptly returned to the people."

sentences.zh: 五年三月，詔：「呂城至鎮江運河淺澀狹隘，監司坐視，無所施設，兩浙專委王復，淮南專委向子諲，同發運使呂淙措置車水，通濟舟運。」

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year, an edict said: "The transport canal from Lücheng to Zhenjiang is shallow, silted, and narrow; supervisory officials sit and watch with nothing undertaken. The two Zhe circuits are specially entrusted to Wang Fu, Huainan to Xiang Ziyin, together with transport commissioner Lü Cong to arrange cart-bucketing of water to open passage for boat transport."
