translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year an edict declared: "The transport canal from Lücheng to Zhenjiang is shallow, silted, and narrow while supervisory officials do nothing. Wang Fu is assigned for the two Zhe circuits, Xiang Ziyin for Huainan, and transport commissioner Lü Cong shall coordinate water wheels to restore boat passage."

sentences.zh: 四月，又命王仲閎同廉訪劉仲元、漕臣孟庾專往來措置常、潤運河。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Wang Zhonghong was again ordered, together with surveillance commissioner Liu Zhongyuan and grain-transport official Meng Yu, specially to go back and forth arranging the Chang and Run transport canals.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Wang Zhonghong was also ordered, together with surveillance commissioner Liu Zhongyuan and grain transport official Meng Yu, to oversee the Chang and Run transport canals.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「東南六路諸閘，啟閉有時。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "The various gates of the six southeastern circuits open and close at set times.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict declared: "Locks throughout the six southeastern circuits must open and close on schedule.

sentences.zh: 比聞綱舟及命官妄稱專承指揮，抑令非時啟版，走泄河水，妨滯綱運，誤中都歲計，其禁止之。」

translations.literal: I have recently heard that convoy boats and commissioned officials falsely claim special receipt of orders, suppressing and causing untimely opening of the boards, running off and leaking river water, hindering and delaying convoy transport, and harming the capital's annual plan—this is forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that convoy boats and commissioned officials falsely claim special orders, forcing locks open at improper times, draining the canals, delaying transport, and harming the capital's annual grain plan. This is forbidden."

sentences.zh: 五月，詔：「以運河淺涸，官吏互執所見，州縣莫知所從。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, an edict said: "Because the transport canal is shallow and dry, officials each hold to their own views, and prefectures and counties do not know whom to follow.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month an edict declared: "Because the transport canal has run shallow, officials dispute one another's views and prefectures and counties do not know whom to follow.

sentences.zh: 其令發運司提舉等官同廉訪使者，參訂經久利便列奏。

translations.literal: Let the transport commission's supervisory and other officials together with surveillance envoys consult and fix lasting benefits and conveniences and memorialize in itemized form.
translations.idiomatic: The transport commission's supervisory officials and surveillance envoys shall jointly devise lasting solutions and memorialize them.

sentences.zh: 」是月，臣僚言：「鎮江府練湖，與新豐塘地理相接，八百餘頃，灌溉四縣民田。

translations.literal: That month, a courtier said: "Lian Lake in Zhenjiang Prefecture connects geographically with Xinfeng Pond, more than eight hundred qing, irrigating the people's fields of four counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month a courtier reported: "Lian Lake in Zhenjiang Prefecture connects with Xinfeng Pond—over eight hundred qing irrigating farmland in four counties.

sentences.zh: 又湖水一寸，益漕河一尺，其來久矣。

translations.literal: Moreover one cun of lake water raises the grain-transport river one chi—this has long been so.
translations.idiomatic: One cun of lake water raises the grain canal one chi—a principle long established.

sentences.zh: 今堤岸損缺，不能貯水，乞候農隙次第補葺。

translations.literal: Now the dikes and banks are damaged and deficient and cannot store water; I beg to wait for gaps in the farming season to repair them in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: The dikes are now damaged and cannot hold water. I ask that repairs proceed in sequence during gaps in the farming season.

sentences.zh: 」詔本路漕臣並本州縣官詳度利害，檢計工料以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered this circuit's grain-transport officials and the prefectural and county officials to examine benefits and harms in detail, check and calculate labor and materials, and report.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit grain transport officials and local prefectural and county officers were ordered to assess costs and benefits, calculate labor and materials, and report back.

sentences.zh: 六年九月，盧宗原復言：「池州大江，乃上流綱運所經，其東岸皆暗石，多至二十餘處；

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the sixth year, Lu Zongyuan again said: "The great river at Chizhou is where upstream convoy transport passes; its east bank is all hidden rocks, in many places reaching more than twenty;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the sixth year Lu Zongyuan reported again: "The great river at Chi Prefecture lies on the upstream convoy route. Its east bank is lined with hidden rocks—more than twenty sites;

sentences.zh: 西岸則沙洲，廣二百餘里。

translations.literal: the west bank is sandbars, two hundred-odd li wide.
translations.idiomatic: the west bank is sandbars stretching over two hundred li.

sentences.zh: 諺雲'拆船灣'，言舟至此，必毀拆也。

translations.literal: A proverb says 'Boat-Dismantling Bay,' meaning that when boats reach here, they are sure to be wrecked and dismantled.
translations.idiomatic: A proverb calls it 'Boat-Dismantling Bay,' for vessels that reach this point are invariably wrecked and broken up.

sentences.zh: 今東岸有車軸河口沙地四百餘里，若開通入杜湖，使舟經平水，徑池口，可避二百里風濤拆船之險，請措置開修。

translations.literal: Now on the east bank there is Chezhou River mouth sand land of more than four hundred li; if it is opened through into Du Lake, causing boats to pass level water and go straight to Chikou, one can avoid two hundred li of wind, waves, and boat-wrecking peril—I request arrangements to open and repair.
translations.idiomatic: On the east bank lies more than four hundred li of sand flats at Chezhou River mouth. If a channel were opened into Du Lake, vessels could travel calm waters directly to Chikou, avoiding two hundred li of wind, waves, and wreckage. I request that plans be made to open and repair the route.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 七年九月丙子，又詔宗原措置開浚江東古河，白蕪湖由宣溪、溧水至鎮江，渡揚子，趨淮、汴，免六百里江行之險，並從之。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the ninth month of the seventh year, an edict again ordered Zongyuan to arrange opening and dredging the ancient river east of the Jiang, from Wuhu by Xuan Creek and Lishui to Zhenjiang, crossing the Yangzi and hastening to the Huai and Bian, avoiding six hundred li of peril on the river route—all was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the ninth month of the seventh year, Zongyuan was again ordered to open and dredge the ancient channel east of the Yangzi from Wuhu via Xuan Creek and Lishui to Zhenjiang, cross the Yangzi, and reach the Huai and Bian—bypassing six hundred li of river dangers. This too was approved.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年三月丁卯，臣僚言：「東南瀕江海，水易泄而多旱，歷代皆有陂湖蓄水。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the third month of the first year of Jingkang, a courtier said: "The southeast borders the river and sea; water easily drains away and drought is frequent; every dynasty has had ponds and lakes to store water."
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the third month of the first year of Jingkang, a courtier reported: "The southeast borders rivers and sea. Water drains away easily and drought is common. Every dynasty maintained ponds and lakes to store water."

sentences.zh: 祥符、慶曆間，民始盜陂湖為田，後復田為湖。

translations.literal: Between Xiangfu and Qingli, the people first stole ponds and lakes for fields; later they again turned fields into lakes.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Xiangfu and Qingli reigns, people first encroached on ponds and lakes for farmland, then later restored fields to lakes.

sentences.zh: 近年以來，復廢為田，雨則澇，旱則涸。

translations.literal: In recent years they have again abandoned [them] as fields; when it rains there is flooding, when drought there is drying up.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years they have again been converted to farmland, bringing floods in rain and drought in dry seasons.

sentences.zh: 民久承佃，所收租稅，無計可脫，悉歸御前，而漕司之常賦有虧，民之失業無算。

translations.literal: The people long held tenancy; the rent and tax collected could in no way be escaped, all going to the imperial privy purse, while the transport office's regular levies suffered loss and the people's loss of livelihood cannot be counted.
translations.idiomatic: Tenants have held these lands for years, and the rents and taxes collected cannot be recovered—all flow to the imperial privy purse. Meanwhile the transport office's regular revenues suffer, and countless people lose their livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 可乞盡括東南廢湖為田者，復以為湖，度幾凋瘵之民，稍復故業。

translations.literal: One may beg to gather fully throughout the southeast those who have abandoned lakes as fields and restore them as lakes, estimating how many withered and afflicted people might slightly recover their former occupations.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that every lake in the southeast converted to farmland be restored, so that impoverished people might gradually regain their former livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 」詔相度利害聞奏。

translations.literal: An edict ordered survey of benefits and harms and memorial reporting.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered a survey of costs and benefits and a memorial report.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，戶部言：「命官在任興修農田水利，依元豐賞格，千頃以上，該第一等，轉一官，下至百頃，皆等第酬獎；

translations.literal: On xinchou, the eighth month, the Ministry of Revenue said: "Commissioned officials who while in office undertake farmland water conservancy, according to the Yuanfeng reward scale—for one thousand qing and above, qualifying for the first grade, one rank promotion; down to one hundred qing, all receive graded rewards;"
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the eighth month the Ministry of Revenue reported: "For commissioned officials who undertake farmland waterworks while in office, under the Yuanfeng reward scale: projects of one thousand qing or more qualify for the first grade and earn one rank of promotion; projects down to one hundred qing receive graded rewards;"

sentences.zh: 紹聖亦如之。

translations.literal: Shaosheng was also the same.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaosheng reign followed the same scale.

sentences.zh: 緣政和續附常平格，千頃增立轉兩官，減磨勘三年，實為太優。

translations.literal: Because the Zhenghe supplement to the Ever-Normal regulations added for one thousand qing a promotion of two ranks and reduction of merit review by three years, it was in truth too generous.
translations.idiomatic: But the Zhenghe supplement to the Ever-Normal regulations added two ranks of promotion and a three-year reduction in merit review for projects of one thousand qing—far too generous.

sentences.zh: 」詔依元豐、紹聖舊格。

translations.literal: An edict ordered following the old scales of Yuanfeng and Shaosheng.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered a return to the Yuanfeng and Shaosheng scales.
